AdachiInlineMask.description: Paint an inpaint mask directly in the workflow.

image.name: image
image.tooltip: Input image path populated by inline upload.

mask_data.name: mask_data
mask_data.tooltip: Editor mask PNG data URL; white repaints.

source_data.name: source_data
source_data.tooltip: Embedded source image for portable workflows.

AdachiInpaintPrepare.description: Crop and prepare masks with exact compositing context; use the all-in-one sampler for latent fill modes.

image.name: image
image.tooltip: Original image; output is restored to this exact size.

area.name: area
area.tooltip: Whole image or mask bounding-box inpainting.

width.name: width
width.tooltip: Sampling canvas width, independent of final image size.

padding.name: padding
padding.tooltip: Mask-only context padding in original pixels.

mask_blur.name: mask_blur
mask_blur.tooltip: Gaussian mask feathering in original pixels.

mask_grow.name: mask_grow
mask_grow.tooltip: Positive dilates; negative erodes the mask.

mask_mode.name: mask_mode
mask_mode.tooltip: Repaint inside or invert the mask.

fill.name: fill
fill.tooltip: Original, surrounding-color fill, latent noise, or zero latent. Latent modes require the all-in-one sampler.

resize_mode.name: resize_mode
resize_mode.tooltip: Whole-image resize mode; mask-only mode always retains the entire mask.

soft_edge.name: soft_edge
soft_edge.tooltip: Extra feathering, not AUTOMATIC1111's Soft Inpainting algorithm.

AdachiInpaintComposite.description: Restore original size and preserve pixels outside the effective mask exactly.

AdachiWebUIInpaint.description: WebUI-style inpainting, crop, latent fill, sampling and original-size compositing.

image.name: image
image.tooltip: Original image; output is restored to this exact size.

area.name: area
area.tooltip: Whole image or mask bounding-box inpainting.

width.name: width
width.tooltip: Sampling canvas width, independent of final image size.

padding.name: padding
padding.tooltip: Mask-only context padding in original pixels.

mask_blur.name: mask_blur
mask_blur.tooltip: Gaussian mask feathering in original pixels.

mask_grow.name: mask_grow
mask_grow.tooltip: Positive dilates; negative erodes the mask.

mask_mode.name: mask_mode
mask_mode.tooltip: Repaint inside or invert the mask.

fill.name: fill
fill.tooltip: Original, surrounding-color fill, latent noise, or zero latent. Latent modes require the all-in-one sampler.

resize_mode.name: resize_mode
resize_mode.tooltip: Whole-image resize mode; mask-only mode always retains the entire mask.

seed.name: seed
seed.tooltip: Seed for a reproducible batch of distinct samples.

denoise.name: denoise
denoise.tooltip: Zero returns the original exactly; one fully denoises.

batch_size.name: batch_size
batch_size.tooltip: Number of generated variants per input image.

refiner_switch.name: refiner_switch
refiner_switch.tooltip: Fraction of steps on the base model when a refiner is connected.

inpaint_model.name: inpaint_model
inpaint_model.tooltip: Enable only for dedicated inpainting models; uses ComfyUI's native InpaintModelConditioning.

soft_edge.name: soft_edge
soft_edge.tooltip: Extra feathering, not A1111 Soft Inpainting.

refiner_model.name: refiner_model
refiner_model.tooltip: Optional compatible refiner model, e.g. SDXL refiner.

refiner_positive.name: refiner_positive
refiner_positive.tooltip: Encode using the refiner CLIP; defaults to original positive conditioning.

refiner_negative.name: refiner_negative
refiner_negative.tooltip: Encode using the refiner CLIP; defaults to original negative conditioning.

AdachiImageCompare.description: Hover to compare; adopt a result into the upstream inline editor.

original.name: original
original.tooltip: Original image shown on the right.

result.name: result
result.tooltip: Full-size generated image shown on the left; use image, not crop.

AdachiExclusiveSwitch.description: Automatically forwards the only enabled input. Bypass one branch; both enabled or both absent is an error.

input_a.name: input_a
input_a.tooltip: First branch. Connect the same data type to both branches and the output.

input_b.name: input_b
input_b.tooltip: Second branch. Exactly one branch must remain enabled.
